title: Grusch's witness and the 300 ft triangle over a car

tellings.quote: but he mentioned a huge 300 ft triangle that somebody uh saw on their way to work.

plain: Someone on their way to work, near Norfolk, Virginia, sometime in the 2010s, saw a huge triangle about 300 feet across. Michels says David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who has testified to Congress about UFOs, told him about this witness. If true, it would be a sighting of a very large craft over an ordinary commute.
